question: Which shared bottlenecks do several NSSTS programs depend on, and which are overdue for a check?
answer: 15 shared bottlenecks sit under the NSSTS programs; the widest, OTA and consortium prototype-to-production transition, touches 6 sectors and 19 company positions, and 6 of the 15 are past their check date with no newer check on record.

sections.title: Ranked by reach

items.title: OTA and consortium prototype-to-production transition
